page.title: Scanner management
page.description: Gate staff accounts, per-event assignments, and check-in history for your live events.

focus.body: Focused on {{event}} — assign staff in the Assignments tab.

logs.title: Scan activity
logs.subtitle: Last 30 check-ins across live events.
logs.emptyBody: Activity appears here once tickets are scanned at the gate.

create.title: Add gate staff
create.description: A login password is generated and emailed unless you set one below. Staff sign in at the scanner app with this email.

fields.name: Name
fields.passwordPlaceholder: Leave blank to email a generated password

validation.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters.

edit.title: Edit gate staff
edit.description: Update display name, login email, password, or account status. Send at least one change, or resend credentials below.

fields.passwordPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep current password

activeAccount.label: Active account
activeAccount.hint: Inactive staff cannot be assigned to events.

emailCredentials.label: Email login credentials
emailCredentials.hint: Sends email with login URL and password. If password is empty above, the server generates one.

resetLogin.title: Reset login without editing fields
resetLogin.description: Generates a new 12-character password and emails it. Assigned gate/event names are included when present.

validation.changeAtLeastOne: Change at least one field before saving.

accounts.toolbarDescription: Edit accounts, resend login emails, or remove staff. Resend generates a new password and emails scanner app login details.
accounts.emptyDescription: Create scanner accounts so your team can check in tickets at event entrances.

assignments.emptyDescription: Publish an event before you can assign gate staff to scan tickets.
assignments.toolbarDescription: Pick an event, then assign or remove gate staff. Multiple scanners can share one entrance.
assignments.watchLiveDisabled: Assign at least one scanner to watch live scans
assignments.emptyAssigned: No staff on this event yet.
assignments.emptyAvailableNoStaff: Add gate staff in the Accounts tab first.
assignments.emptyAvailableAllAssigned: Everyone active is already assigned here.
assignments.inactiveHint: Inactive accounts must be reactivated before assigning.

unassign.title: Unassign from event?
unassign.description: Remove "{{name}}" from "{{event}}"? They can still scan other events they are assigned to.

unassignAll.title: Unassign all from event?
unassignAll.description: Remove all {{count}} scanner(s) from "{{event}}"? Accounts are not deleted.

resendCredentials.title: Resend login credentials?
resendCredentials.description: Generate a new password and email login details to {{email}}? Assigned gate and event names are included when present.

deleteAccount.title: Delete scanner account?
deleteAccount.description: "{{name}}" ({{email}}) will lose scanner app access. All event assignments and registered devices are revoked. This cannot be undone.

resend.resultDescription: A new password was generated for {{name}} ({{email}}) but the email could not be delivered.

tempPassword.shareHint: Share this temporary password with the staff member securely:

toasts.credentialsResentEmailed: New login details were emailed to {{email}}.
toasts.updatedCredentialsEmailed: Updated login details were emailed to {{email}}.

live.title: Live scan feed
live.subtitle: Newest scan results appear at the top.
